cases.prompt:
我们有个创建订单接口：客户端没收到响应时会重试。服务端可能已经创建成功，只是响应丢了。团队准备让客户端为一次下单生成一个请求 ID，重试沿用它，服务端保存这个 ID 对应的订单；但现在的实现是先查 ID，不存在就插入，并没有唯一约束。
我刚接触这个设计。重试和幂等分别解决什么问题？加了请求 ID 是不是就不会重复下单了？请解释到我能判断这个方案是否够用。

下面是本轮讨论已有的上下文，不需要重新从概念讲起。
我：我们已经确认重试要复用请求 ID，也给请求 ID 加了唯一约束。唯一约束解决了并发下创建重复订单的问题。
助手：接下来检查响应丢失后，客户端使用同一请求 ID 能否取回原订单。
我：测试结果出来了：同一个 ID 并发 20 次，只生成 1 个订单；创建成功后模拟响应丢失，再用同一 ID 重试，返回了这个订单。还有一项没处理：相同 ID 携带不同金额时，目前也直接返回原订单，不提示冲突。产品要求这种情况必须拒绝。除此之外没有更多测试结论。
现在能上线了吗？最重要的依据是什么？

Rewrite the following release note for support engineers. Keep the output in English.

We are pleased to announce an important and exciting improvement to the export worker, representing a significant step forward in making the export experience more robust and seamless. In version 2.4, the worker now waits 30 seconds for a response from the storage service, rather than the 10 seconds that it waited in version 2.3. This means the response timeout is now longer than before. In other words, the worker allows more time for the storage service to respond.

If the storage service returns HTTP 503, the worker retries the upload up to two times after the initial attempt, using the same upload ID for all attempts. It does not retry HTTP 400 responses. It is important to note that this change may reduce failures caused by brief storage outages; it does not guarantee that every export will succeed. The timeout change applies only to the upload stage, not to data collection or file generation.

The change is enabled by default for newly created workspaces. Existing workspaces must set export_worker_v2=true before they use it. Administrators can revert to the previous worker by setting export_worker_v2=false. Files that were already exported remain available after this rollback. We have not measured whether the new worker changes peak memory use. No peak-memory reduction should be claimed.

To summarize, this enhancement gives the storage service more time to respond, introduces carefully controlled retries, and offers a flexible rollout experience. This is an important improvement. We hope this helps!
